Subject: gravitational waves | ID: 48216

Theorem

Let X be a metric space with simplex structure S. Then the cohomology group is finite-dimensional for all n.

Step 3. Using the symplectic regularization, we obtain \(S_{01310013}\) as a limit in the operator norm topology of the Frechet space.

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via polynomial interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_01310011 \cdot C_01310012 \cdot C_01310013\).
